mentions.scope: Reaction mixture was added to this tube, dissolved in solvents, sealed, de-gassed, and inflated with N2.
The reaction was heated at 110°C in this oil bath overnight.
The reaction mixture was filtered through this pad.
The filtered solution was loaded onto this column for purification using 30% EtOAc in hexane; several ISCO purifications were carried out.
